title: Pericarp RNA Extraction
author: Alex Rajewski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nw4dfgw

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare all necessary buffers and organize the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Make up lysis buffer using Buffer RLC, 2-mercaptoethanol, and PVP; vortex to mix.
Prepare a batch of RNase-free 80% ethanol (500μL needed per sample) using absolute ethanol and RNase-free water.
Prepare DNase solution for each sample using resuspended DNase (from lyophilized powder) and Buffer RDD; keep on ice.
Prepare an eppendorf tube with 0.5 volumes of absolute ethanol for each sample (e.g., 225μL absolute ethanol for 450μL lysis buffer).
Ensure ethanol is added to Buffer RPE before use.
Arrange and label tubes/columns in order: QIAshredder (lilac), absolute ethanol tube, RNeasy spin column (pink), empty collection tube, and a labeled final collection/storage tube.

steps.title: Grind Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the frozen plant material without allowing it to thaw.

substeps.instruction: Use no more than 100mg of tissue, flash-frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -80ºC.
Place frozen tissue in a cold 2mL round-bottom eppendorf tube with 2-3 stainless steel balls.
Grind tissue using a homogenizer-shaker for ~45 seconds at 30 Hz.
Examine ground tissue for visible clumps; if found, re-cool in liquid nitrogen and repeat grinding.

steps.title: Lysis and Tissue Disruption
steps.instruction: Lyse the tissue powder and remove cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Add 450μl of prepared lysis buffer to a maximum of 100mg tissue powder.
Vortex vigorously.
Optional: Incubate for 1–3 min at 56°C to help disrupt tissue.
Transfer lysate to a QIAshredder spin column (lilac) in a 2 ml collection tube and centrifuge for 2 min at full speed.
Carefully transfer the flow-through to the eppendorf tube containing 0.5 volumes of absolute ethanol, avoiding the cell-debris pellet.

steps.title: RNA Binding and Initial Wash
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the RNeasy column and perform the first wash.

substeps.instruction: Mix the flow-through and ethanol by pipetting gently up and down until homogenous.
Transfer the sample (usually 650μl), including any precipitate, to an RNeasy spin column (pink) in a 2mL collection tube and centrifuge briefly (25 seconds).
Discard the flow-through.
Add 350μl Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge (25 seconds) to wash the membrane.
Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: On-Column DNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination from the bound RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 80μL of the prepared DNase solution directly to the membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Post-Digestion Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane to remove DNase and contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 350μl Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge (25 seconds) to wash the membrane; discard flow-through.
Add 500μl Buffer RPE to the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge (25 seconds) to wash the membrane; discard flow-through.
Add 500μl Buffer RPE again to the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge to wash the membrane.
Add 500μL of 80% ethanol to the RNeasy spin column and centrifuge to wash the membrane; discard flow-through.

steps.title: Column Drying and RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Dry the membrane and elute the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the RNeasy spin column from the collection tube without contacting the flow-through.
Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge with the cap open for 2 minutes to dry the membrane.
Place the RNeasy spin column in a labeled 1.5mL collection tube.
Add 50μl RNase-free water directly to the spin column membrane and centrifuge to elute the RNA.

steps.title: Quantification and Storage
steps.instruction: Analyze the RNA quality and store the sample.

substeps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the sample and the 260/280 and 260/230 ratios.
Record the concentration on the side of the tube.
Store the sample at -80ºC.
